agentBio: Carla has called Dubai home since 2018 and has worked in the city's real estate market since 2022. She works directly with every Nova Casa client — from first enquiry to key handover — to make each transaction clear, informed and personal.
aboutParagraphs: Nova Casa Real Estate is a dynamic real estate company based in Dubai, founded by a Brazilian entrepreneur with a vision to connect international investors and residents with exceptional property opportunities in one of the world's most vibrant cities.

Combining global perspective with local market knowledge, Nova Casa Real Estate specialises in helping clients buy, sell and invest in premium residential and commercial properties across Dubai. The company is committed to transparency, personalised service and building long-term relationships with clients from around the world.

With a strong focus on trust, professionalism and innovation, Nova Casa Real Estate aims to make the property journey seamless — whether clients are looking for their dream home, a profitable investment, or strategic real estate guidance in Dubai's rapidly growing market.
